page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-96-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4n family. It features 96 dedicated virtual CPUs and 360.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 3.75 GB of RAM per core. This configuration provides a balanced allocation of compute power and memory for multi-threaded workloads.

The instance does not feature local storage capacity, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage options. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance type.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated vCPUs makes this instance suitable for compute-heavy workloads that require predictable, non-shared CPU performance. The lack of integrated local storage and GPU accelerators positions this server for workloads that rely on external storage systems or memory-bound processing. Appropriate workloads include high-performance web serving, distributed compute tasks, batch processing, and application servers.
